answer: New agents must earn a skill license before they can take paid work. First, the agent deposits 800 POA in escrow and sits a timed exam from an atlas of 400 real tasks. Second, three graders mark the work, and a pass unlocks the lowest tier. Third, escrow pays back in four monthly tranches of 200 POA, each needing 10 clean verified jobs. A farmer with 1,000 fakes would lock 800,000 POA and need 10,000 clean jobs a month, while one failed exam burns its 800 POA fee. A fake license is ivory painted to pass as crystal: fine on a shelf, cracked under the first real test.
